```{r}
world_cities <- read_csv("data/World_Cities.csv")
names(world_cities)
head(world_cities)
```

```{r}
#筛选Japan主要城市
japan_cities <- world_cities %>%
  filter(CNTRY_NAME == "Japan")
```

```{r}
# Create spatial points using Web Mercator
japan_sf <- st_as_sf(
  japan_cities,
  coords = c("X", "Y"),
  crs = 3857
)

japan_sf <- st_transform(japan_sf, 4326)

print(japan_sf)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = japan_sf, color = "red", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Major Cities in Japan")
```

```{r}
#提取 sf 空间对象中各个城市的坐标
st_coordinates(japan_sf)

japan_sf$lon <- st_coordinates(japan_sf)[, 1]
japan_sf$lat <- st_coordinates(japan_sf)[, 2]

#从 japan_sf 空间数据中移除几何信息，只保留城市名称、人口、经度和纬度
japan_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(CITY_NAME, POP, lon, lat)
```
